items.question: How do I edit my profile?
items.answer: Go to your Profile tab, tap Edit Profile, then update your photo, name, bio, or social links and tap Save.

items.question: How do I change my password?
items.answer: Go to Settings → Change Password, enter your current password, then choose a new one.

items.question: How do I delete my account?
items.answer: Go to Settings → Danger Zone → Delete Account. This permanently removes your account and cannot be undone.

items.question: How do I start a chat?
items.answer: Go to the Chats tab and tap the new chat icon, then pick a friend or search by name.

items.question: How do I forward a message?
items.answer: Long-press any message, tap Forward, then pick one or more chats or groups to send it to.

items.question: Can I unsend a message?
items.answer: Long-press a message you sent and choose Delete. Note this removes it from your view — check your chat's specific delete options for removing it for everyone.

items.question: Why can't I send messages to someone?
items.answer: They may have blocked you, or their privacy settings may require a message request before you can chat freely.

items.question: Why can't I see someone's online status?
items.answer: They may have turned off Online Status in their Privacy settings, or set their visibility to a group that doesn't include you.

items.question: How do I block someone?
items.answer: Open their profile or chat, tap the menu icon, then choose Block. You can manage everyone you've blocked from Settings → Privacy → Blocked Users.

items.question: How do I control who sees my last seen?
items.answer: Go to Settings → Privacy → Online Status Visibility and choose Everyone, My Friends, Specific People, or Nobody.

items.question: How do I enable App Lock?
items.answer: Go to Settings → Privacy → App Lock and turn it on. Your device needs a fingerprint, Face ID, or a screen lock (PIN/pattern/password) set up first.

items.question: How do I mute notifications for a specific chat?
items.answer: Open the chat, tap the menu icon, then choose Mute Notifications.

items.question: Why am I not receiving notifications?
items.answer: Check that notifications are enabled for the app in your device settings, and that you have an active internet connection.

items.question: The app is running slowly, what can I do?
items.answer: Try closing and reopening the app, and make sure you're on the latest version from the app store.

items.question: How do I report a problem?
items.answer: Use Settings → Support → Send Feedback to email us directly, and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

items.question: How do I request a feature?
items.answer: We'd love to hear it! Use Send Feedback and describe what you'd like to see.
